content: We need to list elements that can be definitively identified based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool. Then analyze isotopic patterns. Also retrieve isotopic distribution for reference. Then determine which elements show characteristic isotopic patterns (e.g., Cl has 3:1 Cl-35/Cl-37, Br 1:1, S has 4% 34S, etc). We need to look at the spectrum string. Let's call mass_spectrometry_spectra.
